messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - service `api-router` us-west1 - 5xx rate spike detected. error_rate > 3% over 3m. Incident INC-20260315-1 created and assigned to Amber (oncall). Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20260315-1
Amber (oncall): On it. I’m going to start triage. Paging the SRE rotation.
Amber (oncall): Quick status: 5xxs are predominantly 503s coming from `inference-worker` pool. p95 latency also jumped.
Han: I pushed a config tweak to batch-size on `inference-worker` earlier for throughput. Reverting now.
Amber (oncall): Acknowledged. Can you paste the rollback command?
Han: running:
```
kubectl set env deploy/inference-worker BATCH_SIZE=32 --namespace=redwood-inference
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n redwood-inference
```
Han: Rollback started (rolling restart).
Deploy Bot: deploy/inference-worker: rollback to BATCH_SIZE=32 initiated by Han. Rollout at 3/5 pods ready.
Meera: Seeing error traces referencing `kv-cache` OOM in logs from worker-02. Sample:
```
2026-03-15T15:34:21Z inference-worker-02 stderr: kv-cache: memory allocation failed, cannot store prefix
```
Ryan: Could be combined effect: larger batch -> memory pressure -> eviction -> RPC failures -> 503s.
Amber (oncall): Scaling up worker pool by +2 while rollback completes to reduce immediate 503s. Running:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=7 -n redwood-inference
```
Deploy Bot: scale request accepted. Desired replicas: 7.
Amber (oncall): After scale and restart, error rate dropping from 3.5% -> 0.6% in last 5m. p95 latency back to baseline for most routes.
Ella (product): We got a support ping from AcmeCorp about failed generations around 15:20 PST. They reported roughly 10% of requests returned 503s for ~15 minutes. Marking customer impact: partial degradation for some enterprise customers.
Amber (oncall): Noted. I'll add that to the incident page.
Jordan: Handoff incoming — I’m taking over the incident for the next hour while Amber wraps up pager duties. Brief: config change earlier to batch_size caused memory pressure -> kv-cache OOMs -> 503s. Rollback done by Han, scaled workers, error rates decreasing.
Amber (oncall): Thanks. Summary + timeline posted: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20260315-1/timeline. Handing off to Jordan.
Jordan: I'll monitor for 30m and then transition to postmortem scheduling.
Meera: Quick note — logs show a secondary regression: some routing requests hit a legacy backend variant without kv-cache improvements which magnified failures. Need to verify model routing rules.
Ryan: Action item: add a guard in model-routing that avoids sending large-batch traffic to legacy-variant for 24h. I’ll open the ticket.
Amber (oncall): Can we set immediate pager suppression to avoid noisy alerts while we're stabilizing? Right now alert flaps are paging SREs unnecessarily.
Jordan: Good call. I'll mute the noisy alert for 30m (sustained-errors > 2m) and keep a dashboard watch.
Jordan: muted alert: /alerts/503-spike-api-router for 30m.
Meera: Ok creating follow-ups:
- PM-2319: Rootcause: batch-size change caused memory pressure in kv-cache (owner: Han)
- SRE-7891: Add routing guard to avoid legacy-variant for large-batch traffic (owner: Ryan)
- MON-4420: Reduce pager noise: change paging rule to require sustained 2m and error budget burn > 50% before paging (owner: Jordan)
- DOCS-105: Runbook update: `inference-worker` OOM troubleshooting steps + quick rollback snippet (owner: Amber)
Han: I’ll also pin a canary deploy step in our deploy pipeline to block batch-size > 64 without canary signoff. Creating ticket PRJ-5678.
Ell a (product): Need an incident blurb for customer comms. I can draft something once we have final impact numbers.
Jordan: Current impact estimate: ~10% of requests for ~15 minutes for a subset of customers in US-West and APAC. No data loss, just 503s. Will confirm numbers in the postmortem.
Amber (oncall): Thanks team. I’m logging the immediate mitigation as completed: rollback + scale. Monitoring for 30m.
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-1 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Jordan: Scheduling postmortem: proposed Fri 2026-03-19 10:00 PT (60m). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/pm-INC-20260315-1. Agenda: timeline, root cause, action items, monitoring changes, customer comms.
Meera: That works for me. I’ll prepare logs, flamegraphs, and the routing traces.
Ryan: I’ll attach the reproducer script and the config diff that led to the change.
Han: I’ll bring the deploy pipeline changes proposal (PRJ-5678).
Amber (oncall): I’ll write the initial runbook updates and include rollback commands and checklist.
Jordan: For monitoring/paging improvements we should consider:
- Use adaptive thresholds: dynamic baseline per traffic volume
- Require sustained window + error-budget burn for immediate pages
- Route less-critical alerts to a slack channel (incidents-no-pager) unless escalation needed
- Add health-check synthetic tests for `kv-cache` memory pressure
Jordan: I'll add these to MON-4420.
Ella (product): Postmortem owners: please add customer comms owner so we can get an external note out the same day. Assigning to me for draft.
Meera: Agree. Also recommend we add a regression test to CI that runs a memory stress scenario against `inference-worker` with batch-size extremes. Ticket: QA-998. (owner: Meera)
Jordan: All right — action items created and owners assigned in the incident page. Anyone else?
Amber (oncall): One last ask: reduce alert eval frequency from 15s -> 30s for this rule to cut flapping. I’ll PR to Alerting repo.
Jordan: Noted. I’ll review.
Amber (oncall): Thanks all. Handoff complete. I’m going offline for rotation. :white_check_mark:
Jordan: Monitoring until 16:50 PT then will hand back to SRE rotation. Postmortem invitation sent to invites.
incident-bot: INC-20260315-1: postmortem scheduled Fri 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Remediation tickets: PM-2319, SRE-7891, MON-4420, PRJ-5678.
Ella (product): I’ll prepare customer comms draft and share in #customer-success.
Ryan: I’ll start the PR for routing guard now.
Meera: Uploading traces and logs to incident page.
Han: PRJ-5678 created: https://git.redwood/pr/5678 - includes canary gate and batch-size limits.
Jordan: Closing thread for live coordination — please add any follow-ups to the incident page. We’ll review in the postmortem. :eyes:
